title: 雅思口语 #2 · 食物与健康 / 交通话题
goal: 口语随机话题训练：Part 1 日常问答 ×3、Part 2 事件卡片 ×1、Part 3 延伸讨论 ×2。只出题不批改，自行开口练习；练完点「完成练习」，本卷展示每个话题的地道表达参考（可收藏进短语本）。

questions.prompt:
Let's talk about food and cooking.
- Do you usually cook at home or eat out?
- What is your favourite dish from your country?
- Do you prefer home-cooked meals or takeaway food? Why?

suggestions.en: I'd say I'm a decent cook, but nothing fancy.
suggestions.zh: 我做饭还凑合，但不是什么大厨

suggestions.en: I mostly cook at home during the week.
suggestions.zh: 工作日我基本在家做饭

suggestions.en: Home-cooked meals are healthier and cheaper in the long run.
suggestions.zh: 家常菜更健康，长远看也更省钱

suggestions.en: I grab a takeaway when I'm too tired to cook.
suggestions.zh: 累得不想做饭时我就点外卖

suggestions.en: I'm not a big fan of spicy food, to be honest.
suggestions.zh: 说实话我不是很喜欢辣的

suggestions.en: Cooking is a great way for me to unwind after work.
suggestions.zh: 做饭是我下班后放松的好方式

suggestions.en: My mum makes the best dumplings in the world.
suggestions.zh: 我妈包的饺子天下第一

suggestions.en: I usually follow recipes I find online.
suggestions.zh: 我一般照着网上找的菜谱做

questions.prompt:
Let's talk about public transport.
- How do you usually get around your city?
- Is public transport cheap in your country?
- Would you like to see more bike lanes in your city? Why?

suggestions.en: I commute by metro every day — it's about a 30-minute ride.
suggestions.zh: 我每天坐地铁通勤，大概半小时车程

suggestions.en: The metro system here is well-connected and easy to use.
suggestions.zh: 这里的地铁网四通八达，很好用

suggestions.en: Rush hour is absolutely packed, so I try to leave early.
suggestions.zh: 高峰期人挤人，所以我尽量早点出门

suggestions.en: Traffic jams are a nightmare during the rush hour.
suggestions.zh: 高峰期堵车简直是噩梦

suggestions.en: Cycling is getting more and more popular here.
suggestions.zh: 这边骑车的人越来越多了

suggestions.en: Fares keep going up, which is a bit frustrating.
suggestions.zh: 票价一直在涨，有点让人不爽

suggestions.en: I'd love to see more bike lanes and safer roads for cyclists.
suggestions.zh: 我希望有更多自行车道、对骑车人更安全的路

suggestions.en: Walking is actually my favourite way to get around.
suggestions.zh: 其实走路是我最喜欢的出行方式

questions.prompt:
Let's talk about sports and exercise.
- Do you do any sports or exercise regularly?
- What kind of exercise is popular among young people in your country?
- Do you prefer exercising alone or with friends? Why?

suggestions.en: I work out twice a week at the gym.
suggestions.zh: 我每周去健身房练两次

suggestions.en: Jogging in the park is my way of staying fit.
suggestions.zh: 去公园慢跑是我保持身材的方式

suggestions.en: I'm not really into team sports — I prefer going solo.
suggestions.zh: 我不太喜欢团体运动，更喜欢自己练

suggestions.en: It clears my head after a long day at work.
suggestions.zh: 工作一天后运动能让我头脑清醒

suggestions.en: A sedentary lifestyle is a real problem for office workers.
suggestions.zh: 久坐不动是上班族的真问题

suggestions.en: Exercising with friends keeps me motivated.
suggestions.zh: 和朋友一起练能让我更有动力

suggestions.en: I'm trying to get back into shape after the holidays.
suggestions.zh: 假期过后我正在努力恢复体型

suggestions.en: Even a short walk after dinner makes a difference.
suggestions.zh: 饭后哪怕散散步也很有用

questions.prompt:
Describe a new food or dish you tried for the first time.

You should say:
- what it was
- when and where you tried it
- who you were with

and explain how you felt about it.

suggestions.en: I decided to give it a try even though I was a bit unsure.
suggestions.zh: 虽然心里没底，我还是决定试试

suggestions.en: It was a local delicacy that I'd never heard of before.
suggestions.zh: 那是一道我从未听说过的当地美食

suggestions.en: To be honest, it looked a bit unappetising at first.
suggestions.zh: 说实话，它一开始看着不太有食欲

suggestions.en: The first bite completely surprised me — it was packed with flavour.
suggestions.zh: 第一口完全出乎意料，味道特别足

suggestions.en: It was an acquired taste, but I ended up loving it.
suggestions.zh: 那个味道需要慢慢适应，但最后我爱上了它

suggestions.en: I've been craving it ever since we came back.
suggestions.zh: 回来之后我一直想吃那个味道

suggestions.en: My friend recommended it, so we ordered a big portion to share.
suggestions.zh: 朋友推荐的，我们点了一大份分着吃

suggestions.en: It's definitely something I'd order again.
suggestions.zh: 下次我肯定会再点

suggestions.en: Trying local food is the best part of travelling, in my opinion.
suggestions.zh: 我觉得旅行中最棒的部分就是尝当地食物

suggestions.en: The memory still makes my mouth water.
suggestions.zh: 现在想起来还流口水

questions.prompt:
Part 3 延伸讨论（基于「食物与健康」话题）：
- How have people's eating habits changed in your country over the past few decades?
- Why do you think fast food is so popular despite being unhealthy?
- What should governments do to encourage people to eat more healthily?

suggestions.en: People's eating habits have changed dramatically over the past few decades.
suggestions.zh: 过去几十年人们的饮食习惯发生了巨变

suggestions.en: Processed food has become a major part of the modern diet.
suggestions.zh: 加工食品已成为现代饮食的重要部分

suggestions.en: Fast food is cheap, quick and everywhere — that's the appeal.
suggestions.zh: 快餐便宜、快、到处都有——这就是它的吸引力

suggestions.en: Rising obesity rates are a growing public health concern.
suggestions.zh: 肥胖率上升是日益严重的公共健康问题

suggestions.en: A balanced diet is about variety and moderation, not giving everything up.
suggestions.zh: 均衡饮食在于多样和适度，不是什么都戒掉

suggestions.en: Governments could subsidise healthy options and tax sugary drinks.
suggestions.zh: 政府可以补贴健康食品、对含糖饮料征税

suggestions.en: Clear food labels would help people make informed choices.
suggestions.zh: 清晰的食品标签能帮人们做出知情选择

suggestions.en: Nutrition education in schools would pay off in the long run.
suggestions.zh: 学校的营养教育长期来看会很有回报

questions.prompt:
Part 3 延伸讨论（基于「交通与城市」话题）：
- How can cities reduce traffic congestion?
- Do you think the advantages of owning a car outweigh the disadvantages in big cities? Why?
- How do you think transport will change in the next 20 years?

suggestions.en: Congestion charges and car-free zones have worked well in some cities.
suggestions.zh: 拥堵费和禁车区在一些城市效果不错

suggestions.en: Investing in the metro encourages people to leave their cars at home.
suggestions.zh: 投资地铁能鼓励人们把车留在家里

suggestions.en: Bike-sharing schemes make the last mile much easier.
suggestions.zh: 共享单车让最后一公里方便多了

suggestions.en: In big cities, owning a car is more of a burden than a convenience.
suggestions.zh: 在大城市，养车更多是负担而非便利

suggestions.en: Parking is a nightmare and fuel costs keep rising.
suggestions.zh: 停车难，油价还一直涨

suggestions.en: Electric buses could cut both noise and air pollution.
suggestions.zh: 电动公交能同时减少噪音和空气污染

suggestions.en: Autonomous vehicles may transform how we commute.
suggestions.zh: 自动驾驶可能会彻底改变通勤方式

suggestions.en: The key is to make public transport the most convenient option.
suggestions.zh: 关键是要让公共交通成为最方便的选择
